payload.description: "Redesign Kirwin Bodyworks website with animations, richer brand media, and content scraped from the original kirwinbodyworks.com site

goal.answer: Redesign the Kirwin Bodywork Seminars website with rich GSAP animations, a derived brand palette, and richer media/content scraped from the original kirwinbodyworks.com site, while preserving the existing CMS, booking, payments, i18n, and test infrastructure.

payload.plain: Redesign the Kirwin Bodywork Seminars website with rich GSAP animations, a derived brand palette, and richer media/content scraped from the original kirwinbodyworks.com site, while preserving the existing CMS, booking, payments, i18n, and test infrastructure.

criteria.answer:
Original brand assets (logo, photos, copy) are scraped from kirwinbodyworks.com and stored locally under public/assets/ with a manifest.
A derived color palette and typography scale are configured in tailwind.config.js and applied across public pages and admin UI.
GSAP and @gsap/react are installed and used for scroll-triggered, stagger, and hero animations on public pages.
All public pages (Home, About, Courses, Course detail, Blog list/detail, Contact) are redesigned with cohesive layout, animations, and richer media.
Admin dashboard pages are visually refreshed with the new palette and improved layout while preserving all CMS CRUD behavior.
All existing functionality is preserved: i18n switching, NextAuth login, booking flow, Stripe payment code, CMS CRUD.
npm run test passes (unit/integration baseline updated as needed).
npm run e2e passes (6 Playwright specs baseline or updated count).
npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build all exit 0.

constraints.answer: No changes to database schema or Prisma models unless required by redesign., Preserve existing NextAuth middleware and admin authorization behavior., Keep existing i18n message keys stable or migrate them with matching zh-Hant updates., Do not break existing Vitest or Playwright tests; update selectors/assertions when DOM changes., No production Stripe keys; Stripe integration remains test-mode/env-driven., All work stays under /Users/ios/., Animations must not block core interactions or cause layout shift that fails tests.

plain: No changes to database schema or Prisma models unless required by redesign.
Preserve existing NextAuth middleware and admin authorization behavior.
Keep existing i18n message keys stable or migrate them with matching zh-Hant updates.

No production Stripe keys; Stripe integration remains test-mode/env-driven.

phases.answer: Design Foundation & Asset Pipeline, Public Pages Redesign — Home, About, Contact, Courses, Blog, Booking & Payment Pages Redesign, Admin Dashboard Visual Refresh, Final Verification & Build

assumptions.answer: The user owns the rights to reuse images and copy from kirwinbodyworks.com. GSAP is acceptable as a new dependency. The derived palette will be warm/neutral wellness tones pulled from Stephen's portrait and the original site. Reduced-motion preference will not be enforced per the user's answer, but animations will be togglable in code for future accessibility. The admin UI refresh will be cosmetic (Tailwind classes, spacing, cards) and will not change form validation or server actions. Original site media URLs are stable enough to download once; if a download fails, a placeholder note will be recorded.

charter.intent: Redesign Kirwin Bodyworks website with animations, richer brand media, and content scraped from the original kirwinbodyworks.com site
charter.wowFactor: A visually distinctive, motion-rich bilingual site that feels like a premium wellness brand, with fluid scroll animations and real photography from the original business.
charter.confirmedScope: Public pages (Home, About, Courses, Course detail, Blog list/detail, Contact) plus the admin dashboard get visual and animation redesign. Booking, payments, CMS, i18n, auth, and tests are preserved and updated. Media and copy are scraped from the original site.
charter.demoScript: Open http://localhost:3000 to see an animated hero with Stephen's portrait and logo, scroll to see staggered section reveals, navigate to /about for an animated biography timeline with credentials, /courses for animated course cards, and /admin for a refreshed dashboard. Run npm run e2e to confirm the booking flow still works after the redesign.

payload.summary: Downloaded brand assets from kirwinbodyworks.com to public/assets/: logo, Stephen portrait, course/training/therapy photos. Created public/assets/manifest.json documenting source URLs and descriptions.

Updated tailwind.config.js with derived brand color scales (brand warm neutrals, sage green, terracotta), custom font-family tokens (sans + display), and extended keyframe/animation utilities (fade-up, fade-in, scale-in, slide-in-right).

Rewrote app/globals.css with a warm, wellness-focused palette mapped to shadcn CSS variables: terracotta primary, sage secondary, brand-warm background, and dark-mode equivalents. Added --brand-* custom properties and applied font-display to headings.
Installed gsap and @gsap/react as project dependencies.

Created reusable GSAP animation primitives in components/animations/: AnimatedSection (directional scroll reveals), FadeIn (preset wrapper), StaggerChildren/StaggerItem (scroll-triggered stagger), ParallaxImage (scroll scrub parallax), useScrollReveal hook, and an index barrel export. All components register ScrollTrigger and use useGSAP with scoped refs to avoid leaking triggers.

Added tests/animations/animations.test.tsx with 4 tests verifying GSAP ScrollTrigger registration and that AnimatedSection, FadeIn, and StaggerChildren render children. Installed @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, jsdom; updated vitest.config.ts to use jsdom for .test.tsx files; updated tests/setup.ts with matchMedia mock and jest-dom matchers.

Phase 1 completed (retry). Downloaded original brand assets, created manifest, updated Tailwind theme and globals.css palette, installed GSAP, built reusable animation components, added RTL unit tests, fixed setup.ts to import vi explicitly, and fixed StaggerChildren to avoid double-wrapping StaggerItem children. typecheck and animation tests pass.

grade.rationale: Verified both prior-refusal items are resolved: tests/setup.ts now starts with `import { vi } from "vitest";` and `npm run typecheck` exits 0 with no `Cannot find name 'vi'` errors; tests/animations/animations.test.tsx now asserts AnimatedSection accepts `direction`/`delay`/`as` and renders as the requested `section` tag, FadeIn accepts `direction`/`delay`/`duration`, and StaggerChildren yields exactly three `data-animate="stagger-item"` wrappers (harness `npm run test -- --run tests/animations` passed 4/4). I also ran `npm run lint`, which passes. Scanning the fix wave found no new defects.

Updated en.json and zh-Hant.json with new Home keys. Build passed.

Added contact keys to both locales and updated translation identical-allow list. Build, lint, typecheck pass.

Phase 2 completed (retry 2). Redesigned Home, About, Contact pages with GSAP animations and original media; added 14 page component tests and 3 zh-Hant content regression tests. Cleaned up dead dot-notation keys in messages (home.home.hero.title, about.about.bio, top-level contact.hours) and updated IDENTICAL_ALLOWED (removed contact.hours, added about.bioCaption). Full test suite 190/190 passes; typecheck clean.

grade.rationale: I verified the prior D refusal items are fixed: `messages/en.json` and `messages/zh-Hant.json` no longer contain the dead dot-notation keys `home.home.hero.title`, `about.about.bio`, or a top-level `contact.hours`; `tests/i18n/translations.test.ts` now includes `about.bioCaption` in `IDENTICAL_ALLOWED` and excludes `contact.hours`; re-running that file passes 5/5. The redesigned Home/About/Contact views reference valid keys, the build succeeds, and the harness step-verification matrix is green. The only remaining nits are a couple of unused message keys and the unexercised end-to-end booking flow, which keep the grade from A given this was a retry.
recommendations: Remove the unused `home.hero.headlineAccent` and `about.ctaSecondary` keys from both `messages/en.json` and `messages/zh-Hant.json`; dead catalogue entries will drift and confuse future translators. Check: `grep -R 'headlineAccent\\|ctaSecondary' app components tests` returns no matches and `npm run test -- --run tests/i18n/translations.test.ts` still passes.
Run `npm run e2e` and ensure the booking/payment flow is still green after the redesign; the charter acceptance demo requires it. Check: `npm run e2e` exits 0.

Added courseDetail.instructorName to IDENTICAL_ALLOWED. Build and full test suite pass (198/198).

Redesigned Blog list and detail pages: created components/blog/blog-list-view.tsx and blog-detail-view.tsx with parallax heroes, staggered card animations, typography refresh, instructor callout, and newsletter CTA; refactored server pages to pass data to views; added blog i18n keys. Phase 3 completed (retry). Redesigned Courses listing/detail, Blog list/detail, booking confirmation and payment status pages with cohesive styling and GSAP animations. grade.rationale: Both prior-refusal items are independently verified: components/course-detail/course-detail-view.tsx line 208 passes `priceCents: course.price`, matching the booking form's `priceCents: number` contract, and the Prisma schema confirms `Course.price` is stored in cents. components/courses/courses-view.tsx line 343 adds `group/card` to the `Card` parent, correctly pairing with the `group-hover/card:scale-105` rule on line 350.
